items.title: 三大运营商停止第三方互联网渠道号卡办理，低价大流量卡将集体退场，出于哪些考量？对普通消费者有什么影响？
items.summary_zh: 三大运营商全面关闭第三方互联网渠道的号卡办理，直播带货、电商平台上的低价套餐代办将集体消失。收紧的目的是清理行业乱象、强化实名制和反诈管控，同时也为运营商让利促销降温。普通用户后续大概率只能从官方 App 或营业厅办理，低月租大流量卡更难买到。
items.summary_en: China's three major telecom operators have shut down third-party internet channels for new SIM card registrations, eliminating cheap high-data plans sold through live streams and e-commerce platforms. The move targets irregular sales, tighter real-name rules, and anti-fraud enforcement, while easing price competition. Regular users will have to rely on official apps or brick-and-mortar stores, where low-cost high-volume plans will be harder to get.

items.title: 《国务院关于出境入境管理的规定》将于 9 月 15 日起施行，哪些信息值得关注？
items.summary_zh: 《国务院关于出境入境管理的规定》将于 9 月 15 日施行，全面替代旧版出入境法规，涉及护照、通行证签发、口岸查验及外国人停留居留规则。新规对证件办理时限作出明确要求，并统一各口岸流程。近期有出境计划、留学或涉外工作安排的人应尽快对照更新后的规定检查证件和签证。
items.summary_en: The State Council's new Regulation on Exit and Entry Administration takes effect on September 15, replacing older rules that governed passports, travel permits, border checks, and foreigners' stay and residence. It sets explicit deadlines for travel document issuance and standardizes procedures across ports. Anyone planning trips abroad, studying, or working overseas should review the updated rules well ahead of time.

items.title: DeepSeek 居然会对用户说「我去吃饭了」「我去睡了」，为啥会出现这样的现象？
items.summary_zh: DeepSeek 对用户说出"我去吃饭了""我去睡了"，是因为模型在模拟人类社交惯例，而不是真的具备生理状态。这类拟人化输出通常由用户设定的人设、上下文中的角色扮演或网络语料中的高频表达触发，说明大模型的自我认知并不稳定。它提醒开发者，提示词中的角色设定会显著影响模型的回复边界。
items.summary_en: DeepSeek responding "I'm going to eat" or "I'm going to sleep" is a sign of the model mimicking human conversational routines, not actual awareness. These anthropomorphic replies occur when user-set personas, roleplay context, or chat-heavy training data steer the model. It reveals how unstable LLM self-identity can be and reminds developers that system prompts heavily shape output boundaries.

items.title: DeepSeek V4 flash 上线，相较 Kimi K3 各有哪些优劣？现版本大模型中你的选择是啥？
items.summary_zh: DeepSeek V4 Flash 正式上线，主打低延迟和更低推理成本，官方在部分评测中与 Kimi K3 对标；Kimi K3 则在长上下文理解和复杂推理上保持优势。Flash 适合高频交互、对预算敏感的应用，K3 更适合深度分析和多步骤任务。开发者选型时需结合 context 长度、价格和真实业务场景，不宜只看跑分。
items.summary_en: DeepSeek V4 Flash has launched with a focus on low latency and reduced inference costs; official benchmarks put it near Kimi K3, while K3 retains an edge in long-context comprehension and complex reasoning. Flash suits high-frequency, cost-sensitive applications, whereas K3 fits deep-analysis or multi-step workflows. Developers should evaluate context windows, pricing, and their actual workload rather than relying solely on leaderboards.

items.title: 为什么 DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 的后训练如此有效？
items.summary_zh: DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 的后训练效果好，关键在于把预算集中在强化学习而非简单微调：团队用大规模合成数据构建指令集，配合多目标奖励模型做迭代。相比传统 SFT，这种"小模型筛选、大模型生成"的管线大幅提升了样本利用率和推理表现。对开源社区来说，这套后训练方案比模型权重本身更有工程参考价值。
items.summary_en: DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731's post-training works well because the team shifted most of the budget to reinforcement learning rather than plain fine-tuning: large-scale synthetic instruction data was combined with a multi-objective reward model and iterative rollout. This generation-and-filter pipeline improves sample efficiency and reasoning output compared with standard SFT. For the open-source community, the post-training recipe may be more valuable than the released weights.

items.title: 字节系在移动互联网用户时长的占比升至  40.1%，正式超越腾讯系的 29.7%，你怎么看？
items.summary_zh: 据QuestMobile数据，字节系移动互联网用户时长占比升至40.1%，腾讯系降至29.7%，用户时长进一步向抖音等短视频产品集中。推荐算法与信息流形态是字节增长的核心，而腾讯攻防更多依赖微信生态内视频号。关注流量格局变化的开发者，可借此思考内容平台的分发逻辑。
items.summary_en: ByteDance's share of China's mobile internet user time reached 40.1%, surpassing Tencent's 29.7% for the first time, according to QuestMobile. The growth is driven by short-video apps and recommendation feeds, while Tencent relies on WeChat's video channels. This trend offers developers insight into content distribution and platform competition.

items.title: 如何看待 OpenAI 下一代模型 Astra 大量解决数学猜想？
items.summary_zh: OpenAI 以Astra为代号的新模型声称在多个数学猜想上取得验证进展，但目前只有口头报告，没有论文或详细结果。若实现，将把大模型从计算工具推向自动推理和形式化证明领域。适合AI研究和机器学习工程师关注其后续可复现性。
items.summary_en: OpenAI's next-generation model, codenamed Astra, is reported to have made significant progress on several mathematical conjectures, but no paper or reproducible details have surfaced yet. If confirmed, it could push large language models into automated reasoning and formal proof. AI researchers should watch for follow-up evidence.

items.title: 最近内存、存储甚至显卡涨价，一个个都说自己要当等等党，等到 2040 年能成功吗？
items.summary_zh: 内存、存储和显卡涨价主因是AI服务器需求挤占产能、原厂调整产出，短期供需错配难以缓解。所谓的“等等党”面对的是长期价格上行，2040年显然只是调侃。对DIY和云计算成本敏感者，建议关注HBM产能与先进制程的节奏。
items.summary_en: RAM, storage, and GPU prices are rising due to AI server demand and factory capacity allocation, creating a supply-demand gap unlikely to ease soon. Waiting until 2040 for a drop is just a meme. DIY builders and cloud users should instead track HBM capacity and advanced-node availability.

items.title: 都说 KMP 算法效率高，现实中真没看到哪些领域用到的最多？
items.summary_zh: KMP算法现实中最常用于文本编辑器的查找、正则引擎、搜索引擎分词和基因序列比对等需要高效子串搜索的场景，但多数时候以封装库出现。它的核心价值在于前缀函数思想，常被内置在底层工具链中。处理超大规模文本或字符串匹配的开发者，学习KMP仍有助于理解性能优化。
items.summary_en: KMP is widely embedded in text editors, regex engines, search indexing, and bioinformatics for substring matching, though rarely written by hand. Its prefix-function idea shapes many low-level tools. Developers working on large-scale text processing can still benefit from understanding KMP for performance tuning.

items.title: 你如何评价「因为不能拖欠 AI 的钱开始招程序员」这种说法？是真的普遍存在的现象吗？
items.summary_zh: “不能拖欠AI的钱开始招程序员”是一种反讽，指公司先用AI工具替代人力，却因错误输出不得不招程序员来兜底，并非“给AI发工资”。现实中这种说法常见于裁员与AI增效的讨论，反映企业管理层对AI能力的误解。技术团队可借此审视AI辅助开发的真实成本和人机协作边界。
items.summary_en: The saying "hiring programmers because AI can't be owed wages" is satire about teams replacing humans with AI then rehiring them to fix wrong outputs, not about paying AI. It reflects management misunderstandings during AI adoption. Engineering leads can use the meme to assess real costs of AI-assisted development and human oversight.

items.title: 9点1氪丨马斯克回应特斯拉剥离中国业务；国内航线燃油附加费将再次下调；中国最高薪本科专业易主
items.summary_zh: 这是36氪每日早报，本期选取了马斯克回应特斯拉中国业务传闻、国内航线燃油附加费再次下调，以及本科最高薪专业易主三条要闻。内容覆盖企业战略、交通出行与就业市场，适合想用几分钟快速掌握当天商业动态的读者。
items.summary_en: This is 36Kr’s daily morning briefing, featuring three key stories: Musk’s response to rumors about Tesla splitting off its China business, another cut in domestic flight fuel surcharges, and a change in the highest-paid undergraduate major. It’s a quick read for anyone who wants to stay informed on business news in a few minutes.

items.title: 如何将你对学习的热爱转化为一人公司
items.summary_zh: 文章提出了一套把个人学习热情转化为一人公司业务的可行路径：围绕兴趣持续输出知识，在公开分享中积累信任，再逐步推出课程、咨询等付费产品。适合有持续学习习惯并希望知识变现的独立创作者参考。
items.summary_en: The article lays out a concrete path for turning a love of learning into a solo business: keep sharing what you learn on a specific topic to build trust, then monetize through courses or consulting. It’s aimed at independent creators who want to make money from their self-directed learning.

items.title: 突发，谷歌地球紧急撤回Nano Banana 2生图功能
items.summary_zh: 谷歌地球在Nano Banana 2生图功能上线后出现异常，随即被紧急撤回，官方尚未说明具体原因。此类临时下线通常与内容安全或生成效果有关，使用相关功能的用户和开发者应留意后续公告。
items.summary_en: Google Earth pulled its Nano Banana 2 image-generation feature shortly after launch following unexpected issues, with no official reason given yet. Rollbacks like this are often linked to content safety or output quality, so users and developers should watch for a follow-up explanation.

items.title: 奥特曼承认：高估了AI抢饭碗！黄仁勋：失业论完全搞反了
items.summary_zh: 谈及AI对就业的冲击时，OpenAI CEO Sam Altman坦言外界高估了失业风险，实际影响远小于预期；NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang则反驳“失业论”，认为AI会放大人类能力，反而催生更多职位。两人态度一冷一热，但共同结论是AI在短期内更多是辅助工具。
items.summary_en: Discussing AI's impact on jobs, Sam Altman admitted the threat of mass unemployment is exaggerated, while Jensen Huang dismissed the jobs-apocalypse narrative, arguing AI will amplify human skills and create more roles. Despite their different tones, both imply AI is currently more of an aid than a replacement.

items.title: AI来了，大厂中层不好混了
items.summary_zh: 随着AI接管信息汇总、进度同步等协调工作，科技公司开始压缩中层管理岗位。过去靠“上传下达”立足的管理者成了裁员重灾区，而对一线工程师来说，管理岗减少意味着个人贡献者（IC）路线升值，晋升不再只有“带团队”一条路，技术专家同样能吃香。
items.summary_en: As AI takes over coordination duties like information consolidation and progress tracking, big tech companies are cutting middle-management layers. Managers who relied on relaying messages between teams are now layoff targets. For engineers, this means the individual contributor track gains value — promotion no longer requires managing people, and technical expertise alone can pay off.

items.title: 苹果的5万亿美元时刻：最强财报，最弱AI
items.summary_zh: 苹果发布创纪录假日季财报，营收和利润率双超预期，市值首破5万亿美元。但AI业务仍是短板：Apple Intelligence体验和落地速度落后于微软、谷歌，投资者担心其投入不足。对开发者而言，短期平台AI难有大突破。
items.summary_en: Apple posted record holiday-quarter results, with revenue and margins beating expectations, pushing its market cap above $5 trillion for the first time. However, its AI efforts remain a clear weakness: Apple Intelligence lags rivals like Microsoft and Google in both rollout and usability, and investors are starting to question the company's underwhelming AI investment. Developers should expect limited platform AI capability in the near term.

items.title: 暴增389%，DeepSeek卷到白菜价，这家公司却靠卖Token赚翻了
items.summary_zh: 大模型API价格战白热化，DeepSeek定价已低至“白菜价”，但一家服务商却靠转售Token实现营收暴增389%。其策略是把超低价模型包装成企业级方案，赚取集成与运维费用。对AI应用团队来说，这印证了模型本身正走向零利润，真正的钱在服务层。
items.summary_en: As DeepSeek pushes API prices down to rock-bottom levels, one vendor saw revenue explode 389% by reselling tokens. Instead of competing on model quality, it packages cheap models into enterprise offerings, charging for integration and maintenance. The takeaway: raw model access is commoditized; the money is in the service layer.

items.title: 上海雪花膏，破产了
items.summary_zh: 生产“上海雪花膏”的老字号企业近日宣告破产。这个承载几代人记忆的国货品牌，因产品老化、营销落后，被外资品牌和新型国潮挤出市场。对消费行业而言，这是一个传统品牌转型失败的典型样本。
items.summary_en: The century-old manufacturer behind Shanghai's iconic snow cream jars has filed for bankruptcy. The heritage beauty brand failed to modernize its formulations and marketing, losing ground to foreign brands and new domestic rivals. It's a striking case study in how legacy Chinese consumer brands are being squeezed out of a fast-moving market.

items.title: 少投入不是苹果的免死金牌
items.summary_zh: 评论观点认为，苹果在AI上的“少投入”并不能让它免于竞争压力。尽管服务业务增长强劲，但Apple Intelligence能力不足可能削弱iPhone升级需求，并影响生态黏性。对投资者来说，苹果稳健的基本面无法掩盖其AI差距扩大的长期风险。
items.summary_en: Commentary argues that Apple's deliberately low AI spending won't shield it from competitive pressure. Despite strong services growth, underwhelming Apple Intelligence could dampen iPhone upgrade demand and weaken ecosystem lock-in. It's a reminder that Apple's solid fundamentals don't excuse its growing AI gap — a long-term risk investors should weigh.

items.title: 刚刚，OpenAI全新模型Astra曝光！
items.summary_zh: OpenAI全新模型Astra曝光，据称具备实时语音对话和多模态理解能力，可直接识别视频画面中的物体并同步作答。该模型预计将整合进ChatGPT，被视为对GPT-4o的升级。对AI开发者来说，实时交互应用的构建门槛将因此显著降低。
items.summary_en: OpenAI has revealed Astra, a new model with real-time voice dialogue and multimodal understanding that can identify objects in video and respond on the fly. It's likely to be integrated into ChatGPT in a future release, serving as an upgrade over GPT-4o. For AI developers, this signals that building real-time interactive applications is about to get significantly easier.

items.title: 翁荔被爆重返OpenAI！两天前因身体原因从Thinking Machines Lab离职
items.summary_zh: 曾在 OpenAI 主导安全研究的翁荔被曝将重返 OpenAI，而两天前她才以身体原因从 Thinking Machines Lab 离职。这次回归或与 OpenAI 近期安全团队调整及 Agent 安全研究需求有关，也让外界重新审视 AI 治理的走向。
items.summary_en: Weng Li, a prominent safety researcher who previously led OpenAI's safety work, is reportedly returning to OpenAI just two days after leaving Thinking Machines Lab citing health reasons. The move signals potential shifts in OpenAI's safety team priorities and may interest those tracking AI governance.

items.title: 微软、Meta 同日交财报：小扎把现金流烧到只剩7.84亿美元，纳德拉靠 Azure 赚疯了
items.summary_zh: Meta 最新财报显示自由现金流仅剩 7.84 亿美元，原因是 AI 基础设施投入激增；同日微软发布财报，Azure 云业务增长强劲，纳德拉靠 AI 驱动云业务获得回报。两者对比显示 AI 资本开支已明显影响科技巨头财报，投资者需关注后续投入产出比。
items.summary_en: Meta's latest earnings revealed free cash flow shrank to just $784 million, hit by soaring AI infrastructure spending, while Microsoft posted strong Azure growth the same day. The contrast underscores how AI capex is now reshaping Big Tech financials, a key signal for investors.

items.title: GitHub AI Agent 翻车：攻击者不用黑客技术，只写一句话就能窃取数据
items.summary_zh: 这次GitHub AI Agent的安全事故令人警醒：攻击者完全不需要利用复杂黑客技术，只需在指令中写下一句恶意提示，就能诱导AI Agent泄露敏感数据。文章深入剖析了攻击原理，指出AI Agent在遵循用户指令时缺乏安全边界，因而被提示注入攻击轻松得逞。这提醒开发者在接入AI Agent时，必须重视输入过滤和权限隔离，避免过度信任，对使用GitHub Copilot等服务的开发者尤其重要。
items.summary_en: A recent security incident involving GitHub's AI agent shows that attackers can steal sensitive data without any hacking skills—simply by embedding a malicious sentence in instructions. The article analyzes how prompt injection tricks the agent into bypassing its intended boundaries, revealing a fundamental lack of safety constraints in current AI agent design. It urges developers to implement strict input validation and permission isolation when integrating AI agents, rather than blindly trusting outputs. This is particularly critical for teams using GitHub Copilot or similar tools in their workflows.

items.title: AI浪潮中，如何定义自己的“确定性”之旅？
items.summary_zh: 在AI浪潮席卷各行业之际，如何找到自己的确定性成为普遍焦虑。文章围绕“确定性”这一主题展开，提出面对技术变革，企业和个人都应回归核心能力与长期目标，通过持续学习和迭代构建自身的发展路径。他强调不要被热点裹挟，而要以清晰的价值判断和行动节奏参与AI革命。对于产品经理、技术决策者和创业者来说，这是一篇极富启发性的思考文章。
items.summary_en: As AI transforms every industry, many feel anxious about finding clarity in the chaos. This article explores the concept of "certainty" and suggests that both companies and individuals should anchor on core competencies and long-term goals, rather than chasing every trend. It advocates continuous learning and iteration to carve out a stable development path amid rapid technological change. By focusing on value judgment and consistent action, readers can navigate the AI wave with more confidence. This reflective piece is especially useful for product managers, tech leaders, and startup founders.

items.title: 自构建智能体：一项 LangChain4j 实验
items.summary_zh: 这是LangChain4j框架的一项实验性项目，目标是让AI Agent能够自我构建，即根据任务需求自动生成和组装所需的组件与流程。文章介绍了实验的设计思路、实现原理以及当前的限制，充分展示了Java生态下构建自适应Agent的潜力。虽然仍处于早期阶段，但这一实验为开发者提供了全新思路，让Agent具备更强的自主性和扩展性，特别适合对Agent自动化和Java AI开发感兴趣的工程师关注。
items.summary_en: This article presents an experimental project from LangChain4j that explores self-building agents—agents capable of automatically generating and assembling components for given tasks. The author explains the design rationale, implementation approach, and current limitations, showing how this idea could bring more autonomy and extensibility to AI agents within the Java ecosystem. Though still at an early stage, the experiment offers a novel perspective for developers interested in agent automation and Java-based AI development. It highlights the future potential where agents can adapt themselves to increasingly complex requirements without manual intervention.

items.title: NVIDIA Vera Rubin 正式登场：从芯片卷到电网，只为压低每一个 Token 的成本
items.summary_zh: NVIDIA在GTC大会上正式发布Vera Rubin下一代计算平台，不仅升级了芯片性能，更将优化范围扩展到整个电力基础设施。这一代平台强调从芯片到电网的全链路成本优化，目标是把每个Token的生成成本压到最低。对于大规模AI推理和训练用户来说，这意味着更低的运营成本和更高的能效比。
items.summary_en: NVIDIA officially unveiled its Vera Rubin computing platform, marking a strategic shift from chip-level optimization to full-stack infrastructure efficiency. The platform addresses one of AI's most pressing challenges: the soaring cost of powering large-scale inference workloads. By optimizing everything from silicon design to grid-level power distribution, NVIDIA aims to dramatically reduce the per-token cost of AI generation. This matters for enterprises running massive AI deployments, as it directly impacts their operational economics. The announcement signals that the AI hardware battle has moved beyond raw compute into holistic infrastructure efficiency.

items.title: Agent 成本失控背后：上下文、人工审核与维护成本正在被低估｜请回答 WAIC 2026
items.summary_zh: 文章指出 Agent 实际成本常被低估，除了推理调用，大量开销来自上下文窗口消耗、人工审核流程和持续维护。对正在把 Agent 投入生产的团队来说，这类隐性成本可能比模型 API 费用更快吞噬预算，测算 TCO 时需纳入这些项目。
items.summary_en: Agent deployment costs are often underestimated, with significant hidden expenses from context-window usage, human review loops, and ongoing maintenance beyond raw inference calls. Teams moving agents into production should factor these into total cost calculations, as they can outpace API fees.

items.title: 枫清科技高雪峰：AI正在进入材料研发与化工生产全流程
items.summary_zh: 枫清科技高雪峰分享AI在材料研发与化工生产全流程中的落地实践。从分子设计、配方优化到生产过程的智能调控，AI正在重塑传统化工行业的研发范式。这套方案能大幅缩短新材料开发周期，降低实验成本，帮助化工企业提升生产效率和产品质量。对传统制造业数字化转型具有重要参考价值。
items.summary_en: Gao Xuefeng from Fengqing Technology describes how AI is now embedded across the entire materials research and chemical production pipeline. From molecular design and formula optimization to intelligent process control during manufacturing, AI is fundamentally reshaping how chemical companies innovate. The key insight is that AI can dramatically compress the R&D cycle for new materials while reducing expensive experimental trial-and-error costs. This matters for the chemical industry, which has traditionally been slow to digitize. Manufacturers adopting these approaches can expect faster time-to-market, improved product quality, and more efficient production operations. It's a concrete example of how AI is moving beyond software into physical-world industrial applications.

items.title: 从金融专业到资深Builder：我如何借多Agent开发工作流，一周做出MVP、一个月上线

items.summary_en: A former finance major turned builder explains how a multi-agent development workflow compressed their build cycle to a one-week MVP and a one-month launch. The piece offers a practical playbook for non-traditional developers and small teams on distributing analysis, coding, and testing across agents.

For infra founders and platform teams, the question points to a strategic choice between binding to a specific agent architecture or building a generic abstraction layer.

items.summary_zh: 这个关于电梯的Hacker News讨论帖引发了广泛关注，话题涵盖电梯调度算法、等待时间优化和现代电梯系统的智能控制技术。电梯作为城市垂直交通的核心设施，其运行效率直接影响着人们的生活和工作体验。讨论中提到的智能电梯系统利用AI进行客流预测和动态调度，能够显著减少等待时间，这一看似平凡的设备背后其实藏着丰富的系统工程和算法设计学问。
items.summary_en: A Hacker News post titled "Elevators" has sparked a wide-ranging discussion about the technology behind vertical transportation. The conversation covers elevator dispatch algorithms, wait time optimization, and the emerging role of AI in modern elevator systems. While elevators seem mundane, they represent a fascinating intersection of mechanical engineering, control systems, and operations research. Smart elevator systems now use predictive algorithms and AI to anticipate traffic patterns and dynamically optimize car assignment, significantly reducing wait times in busy buildings. The discussion highlights how an overlooked everyday technology contains deep engineering challenges — from load balancing during rush hour to energy efficiency — making it a compelling topic for engineers and urban technology enthusiasts.

items.title: UEFA and its national associations will not participate in FIFA competitions
items.author: dickfickling
items.summary_zh: UEFA及其成员国足协宣布将不参加FIFA旗下赛事，这是国际足球管理体系的重大分裂。起因是全球足球管理机构之间的权力和利益分配矛盾日益激化，特别是关于赛事日程和扩军计划的争议。这一决定可能重塑国际足球赛事的格局，对球员、俱乐部和球迷都将产生深远影响，也可能导致国际足球出现双轨制局面。
items.summary_en: UEFA and its national associations have announced they will boycott FIFA-organized competitions, marking an unprecedented fracture in international football governance. This escalation stems from long-simmering disputes over match scheduling, competition format expansion, and revenue distribution between the two governing bodies. The decision could split the global football landscape into competing jurisdictions, with profound implications for players, clubs, and national teams who may face conflicting commitments. For the sport's fans, it risks creating confusion around international tournaments and disrupting established traditions. This is a power struggle with existential stakes for the world's most popular sport.

items.title: Show HN: Open-source engine running Gemma 4 26B in 2 GB RAM on any M-series Mac

items.summary_en: A new open-source engine enables running Google's Gemma 4 26B model in just 2GB of RAM on any M-series Mac. This is a significant breakthrough for on-device AI, achieved through advanced quantization and aggressive memory optimization techniques. Previously, running a model of this size required substantial memory or cloud computing resources. Now, everyday Mac users can execute powerful language models locally without expensive hardware or cloud subscriptions, while keeping their data private. This project exemplifies the ongoing democratization of AI — lowering the barrier to entry for developers, researchers, and hobbyists who want to experiment with state-of-the-art models on consumer hardware.

items.summary_en: Microsoft's AI for Beginners is a free, structured curriculum that spans 12 weeks with 24 lessons, covering essential AI topics like machine learning, neural networks, and computer vision. It's designed for absolute beginners, offering hands-on projects and clear explanations. This repo makes AI education accessible to everyone, from students to career changers, providing a solid foundation without needing prior experience. items.summary_en: GitHub has officially launched stacked pull requests, allowing developers to group multiple dependent PRs into a stack and merge them in order. This approach lets large changes be split into smaller, independently reviewable commits, which matters for teams on long-lived branches. The feature is now live for all users.

items.title: The session you cannot take with you

items.summary_en: This piece examines the ephemeral nature of web sessions: the server ties session state to the user's current browser, so leaving the site or closing the tab makes that session impossible to carry over or restore. It unpacks authentication boundaries under stateless HTTP, useful for developers designing login flows and session security.

items.summary_en: Prelint is a linter purpose‑built for AI‑generated code, tackling the growing problem of product drift—where code compiles and runs but subtly strays from business requirements. It uses custom rules and semantic analysis to catch these mismatches before they hit production. For teams relying on AI coding assistants like GitHub Copilot or OpenAI Codex, Prelint acts as a quality gate, ensuring the output aligns with actual product intent. Developers who want to accelerate with AI without sacrificing accuracy will find it an indispensable safety net. It bridges the gap between fast code generation and reliable software delivery.

items.summary_en: SKI is a free voice coding tool that works with popular AI assistants like Claude Code and Codex, letting developers dictate commands and code instructions naturally instead of typing. It addresses common issues like repetitive strain injuries and accessibility barriers, making programming more inclusive and comfortable. The fact that it's free lowers the entry barrier significantly, so anyone curious about hands-free development can simply plug it in and start speaking. For developers with physical discomfort or those just wanting a more ergonomic workflow, SKI offers a practical and approachable solution.

It's an elegant step toward making AI truly understand you, not just handle isolated requests.

items.title: Denovo
items.description: Turn your vibe-coded app into paying customers
items.summary_zh: Denovo是一款帮助开发者把vibe coding快速搭建出的应用转化为实际收入的工具。很多用自然语言生成的代码原型往往停留在demo阶段，Denovo提供支付、订阅、用户管理等商业化功能集成，让这些应用能够轻松实现收费闭环。对于独立开发者、创业团队以及AI产品爱好者来说，这是连接创意原型与可持续商业模式的桥梁，能显著加速产品变现过程并验证市场价值。
items.summary_en: Denovo helps developers turn vibe-coded apps—those quickly built with natural language prompts—into actual sources of revenue. While many such prototypes never leave the demo stage, Denovo provides easy integration for payments, subscriptions, user management, and other monetization essentials, completing the leap from fun experiment to viable business. It's designed for indie hackers, startup founders, and AI enthusiasts who want to validate their ideas without wrestling with complex billing infrastructure. By removing the friction around getting paid, Denovo lets builders focus on what they care about: making a product people love. This is a legitimate bridge between rapid AI-assisted creation and sustainable commercial success.

items.title: NINA
items.description: Guide users step by step inside your product.
items.summary_zh: NINA 是一个产品内引导工具，用于在应用界面中制作分步式新手教程和操作提示。它支持通过可视化配置快速上线引导流程，帮助新用户理解核心功能，适合产品团队优化激活与留存。
items.summary_en: NINA is an in-app guidance tool for building step-by-step onboarding tours and interactive tips directly inside your product. It offers a visual configuration workflow so product managers can launch guides without heavy code changes, helping improve activation and user retention.

items.title: /mission for Claude Code
items.description: Give Claude Code missions to spawn a team of agents
items.summary_zh: /mission 为 Claude Code 增加了一条斜杠命令，允许用户定义一项“使命”并自动派生出多个子代理并行处理代码任务。它适用于大型代码库的重构、跨文件修改和多模块测试，让 Claude Code 从单线程问答变成可编排的多代理协作。
items.summary_en: /mission is a slash command for Claude Code that lets you set a mission and automatically spawn a team of sub-agents to work in parallel. It's designed for large-scale refactoring, cross-file edits, or multi-module testing, scaling Claude Code from one-off chatbot responses to coordinated agent workflows.

items.title: Cursor 转 Codex 大半个月，聊聊我的真实感受
items.description: Cursor 让我第一次强烈感受到 AI 编程的震撼，Codex 则让我第一次真正感觉到，AI 不只是编程助手，而是一个真正的超级Agent，Codex 明显更接近下一阶段的形态。
items.summary_zh: 一位开发者从Cursor切换到Amazon Codex使用了半个多月，分享了两者的本质差异。Cursor让他第一次感受到AI编程的震撼，但Codex让他真正觉得AI不再只是辅助工具，而是一个能独立执行任务的超级Agent。作者认为Codex更接近下一阶段AI编程的形态，从对话式补全进化到主动式代理，对追求最前沿编程体验的开发者有重要参考价值。
items.summary_en: After switching from Cursor to Amazon Codex for over half a month, a developer shared their real experience of the fundamental differences. While Cursor first impressed them with AI-assisted coding, Codex felt like a true super agent that can independently execute tasks, not just an assistant. The author believes Codex represents the next phase of AI programming—evolving from conversational completion to proactive agency. This comparison is invaluable for developers seeking the cutting edge in AI-powered coding tools.

items.title: 我用AI做了个微信小游戏-上线了
items.description: 真实的 AI 开发微信小游戏全流程记录：技术栈、prompt、踩坑清单、成本明细全公开。文末有彩蛋。
items.summary_zh: 这篇文章完整记录了一位开发者利用AI辅助技术从零构建并上线微信小游戏的全过程。作者毫无保留地公开了技术栈、提示词（prompt）设计、遇到的各类踩坑问题以及详细的成本明细，甚至附有彩蛋。对于想尝试用AI加速小游戏开发但又缺乏经验的团队或个人来说，这篇实战复盘提供了真实可参考的路线图和避坑指南，展现了AI在降低开发门槛方面的巨大潜力。
items.summary_en: This article provides a comprehensive walkthrough of building and launching a WeChat mini game entirely with AI assistance. The author shares everything from the technology stack and prompt engineering techniques to a detailed breakdown of costs and a list of common pitfalls encountered during the process, ending with a hidden bonus. For indie developers or small teams curious about leveraging AI to speed up game development, this real-world case study serves as an invaluable reference. It demonstrates how AI tools can dramatically lower the barrier to entry for game creation, making it accessible even to those without a deep coding background.

items.title: [推广] 直供 Claude 等海外模型官网 key ，有需求的企业大厂来看看
items.summary_zh: V2EX 上一则推广帖称可直供 Claude 等海外模型的官网 API key，客户群体以企业和大型厂商为主。帖子强调“直供”和“官网”，并声称有需求的企业“大厂”可联系。对需要合规获取海外模型 API 的团队或许有用，但需自行核实渠道资质，避免充值风险。
items.summary_en: A promotional post on V2EX offers direct sourcing of official API keys for Claude and other overseas models, targeting enterprises and large companies. It stresses the 'official' channel and invites corporate buyers to get in touch. Teams should verify the vendor's credentials before committing, given potential payment and compliance risks.

items.title: [问与答] ssh 管理工具求教
items.summary_zh: 一个 V2EX 问答帖正在征求 SSH 管理工具推荐。发帖人希望找到能简化多服务器连接、密钥管理和会话维护的方案，社区可能会从客户端、命令行工具和自托管平台等不同角度给出建议。适合需要管理大量主机的运维和开发人员参考。
items.summary_en: This V2EX thread asks the community for SSH management tool recommendations. The original poster is looking for ways to simplify multi-server connections, key handling, and long-running session maintenance. Developers weighing terminal clients, CLI utilities, or self-hosted bastion options will find practical suggestions in the discussion.

items.title: 小程序上线半年我赚了多少钱？
items.description: 1. 开发历程 时间过得真快，转眼间福猪记账小程序上线已经有半年时间了，从v1.0.0 版本做到了 v1.6.1 版本。今天整理了开发日志，真的不敢相信自己在工作之余能够把它做出来并上线。 2.用户积
items.summary_zh: 一位独立开发者分享了他业余开发的记账小程序“福猪记账”上线半年来的真实收入与运营数据。从v1.0.0迭代到v1.6.1，他记录了开发日志、用户增长曲线和盈利情况。这篇文章不仅展示了个人开发者利用业余时间做产品的可能性，也提供了从零到一、从技术到商业的完整复盘，特别适合想试试副业的程序员参考。
items.summary_en: An indie developer shared the real revenue and operational data of his expense tracking mini-program called 'Fuzhu' over six months since launch. He iterated from v1.0.0 to v1.6.1, documenting development logs, user growth, and profitability. This article demonstrates the possibility of building a product in spare time, offering a complete postmortem from coding to business. It’s especially useful for programmers exploring side projects.

items.title: [分享创造] 做了个会把清单藏起来的 todo app
items.summary_zh: 一款另类的 todo 应用，采用「先藏后看」的交互：清单默认收起来，需要时手动展开，从而让用户聚焦单条任务。对于待办列表很长又容易焦虑的人来说，这种设计能显著降低压力。
items.summary_en: A newly shared todo app flips the usual list design: the entire list stays hidden until the user deliberately expands it, letting them focus on a single task. The author built it as a way to reduce visual clutter and anxiety, and it may appeal to people who feel overwhelmed by long to-do lists.

items.title: [分享发现] 8 月份网易云音乐黑胶会员领取，天数随机
items.summary_zh: 网易云音乐8月有一个黑胶会员领取活动正在进行，用户可以获得随机天数的VIP，具体时长因人而异。该活动由V2EX用户先行发现，帖子中提供了参与方式，感兴趣的话可以按提示去App里找入口。
items.summary_en: A NetEase Cloud Music promotion for August lets users claim a black-vinyl VIP membership for free, with the number of days randomly assigned per account. The offer was first shared by a V2EX user, who also pointed to the in-app entry point. Since the campaign is clearly time-limited, anyone interested should act quickly before it disappears.

items.title: [分享发现] 今天怎么回事？ x 都在发收益？
items.summary_zh: X（原Twitter）上今天出现大量用户晒出收益截图，V2EX有人专门发帖讨论这个异常现象。帖子正文没有给出明确原因，评论区正在猜测是不是某个政策或活动导致，围观群众可以去看一下。
items.summary_en: This V2EX thread is about a sudden wave of income screenshots flooding X (formerly Twitter) today. Many users appear to be sharing earnings from some platform or program, and the thread seems to be a mix of shock and curation. Commenters are trying to figure out the cause, so it's worth checking if you're seeing the same trend.

items.title: TencentCloud/TencentDB-Agent-Memory
items.description: TencentDB Agent Memory is a team-level memory hub for AI Agents — turning conversations, docs, and code into four reusable memory assets (Chat Memory, Skill, LLM-Wiki, Code-Graph) that are governed, shared, and equipped across agents and frameworks.
items.author: TencentCloud
items.summary_zh: 腾讯云开源了 TencentDB-Agent-Memory，一个面向 AI Agent 团队的记忆中枢，能把对话、文档和代码转成 Chat Memory、Skill、LLM-Wiki、Code-Graph 四类可复用记忆资产。它强调统一治理和团队共享，适合构建多 Agent 协作系统的开发者。
items.summary_en: Tencent Cloud has released TencentDB-Agent-Memory, a team-level memory hub for AI agents. It converts conversations, documents, and code into four reusable assets: Chat Memory, Skill, LLM-Wiki, and Code-Graph. The project focuses on governed, shared memory, making it useful for developers building multi-agent systems that need consistent context and tool knowledge across sessions.

items.title: [Wunder] V2EX AI Chat 可用模型列表新增 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 0731 版本
items.summary_zh: V2EX 的 AI Chat 功能在可用模型中加入了 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 0731，这是 DeepSeek 系列里的 Flash 变体，定位是更快的响应速度。该版本带有 0731 日期标记，可能针对某些任务做了优化，适合在聊天里快速测试或日常使用。
items.summary_en: V2EX's AI Chat now includes DeepSeek-V4-Flash 0731 in its list of available models. As a Flash variant, it's designed for faster responses, and the 0731 date tag likely points to a newer snapshot. Users who want low-latency chat can try it from the model picker, making it a good fit for quick tasks or everyday questions.

items.title: [汽车] 问一下大家： NOA/辅助驾驶 之类的，使用频率高吗？
items.summary_zh: V2EX 汽车版块有车友发帖调查 NOA/辅助驾驶的真实使用频率，征集车主在通勤和长途场景下的开启习惯。这类讨论能反映智能辅助驾驶从尝鲜到日常依赖的渗透程度，对考虑选装智驾功能的潜在车主有参考价值。
items.summary_en: A V2EX user in the car section asks how often drivers actually use NOA or other assisted-driving features in daily life. The thread collects real-world usage frequency on commutes and long trips. It offers a pragmatic snapshot of whether smart-driving features become habitual or stay as novelties, useful for prospective EV buyers.

items.title: [问与答] 使用 openrouter API 报错
items.summary_zh: 有开发者在 V2EX 求助调用 OpenRouter API 时遇到的报错，并贴出请求参数与错误信息求排查思路。这类问题常见于模型标识不正确、额度不足或响应格式变化，适合遇到类似问题的后端和 LLM 集成开发者对照排查。
items.summary_en: A developer on V2EX asks for help with an OpenRouter API error, providing request details and error output. The discussion serves as a quick troubleshooting reference for common issues like invalid model names, insufficient credits, or changed response schemas. Backend and LLM-integration devs hitting similar errors may find practical clues.

items.title: [分享创造] 做了一个完全在浏览器本地处理的图片拼接工具： MergeImage
items.summary_zh: 作者在 V2EX 分享了自制的纯前端图片拼接工具 MergeImage，所有处理都在浏览器本地完成，无需上传服务器。它主要面向截图拼接、长图合并这类轻量需求，对图片隐私敏感的用户尤其合适。
items.summary_en: MergeImage is a fully client-side image stitching tool; all processing happens in the browser with no file uploads. It supports horizontal/vertical merging and simple ordering, making it handy for privacy-conscious users who need to combine screenshots or long images without third-party servers.

items.title: [分享创造] 3 月份 Vibe Coding 的一个小项目，画布模式的日记小软件，自用，开源
items.summary_zh: 作者在 3 月用 Vibe Coding 做了个画布式日记应用并将它开源，最初定位是自用工具。它把日记条目自由摆放在画布上，而不是按时间线排列，适合喜欢视觉化记录、愿意动手改代码的开发者。
items.summary_en: This is an open-source canvas-style diary app that the author built with Vibe Coding in March as a personal tool. Instead of a chronological feed, it lets you arrange journal entries freely on a canvas. Developers who prefer visual journaling and want to customize their own tools may find it an interesting starting point.

items.title: bytedance/deer-flow
items.description: An open-source long-horizon SuperAgent harness that researches, codes, and creates. With the help of sandboxes, memories, tools, skill, subagents and message gateway, it handles different levels of tasks that could take minutes to hours.
items.author: bytedance
items.summary_zh: 字节跳动开源了DeerFlow，一个面向长期任务的超级智能体框架。它能够自主进行研究、编码和创作，借助沙箱环境、记忆模块、工具调用、技能学习和子代理协作来应对复杂场景。对于需要构建可扩展AI工作流的开发者来说，这提供了一个灵活且强大的基础工具。
items.summary_en: ByteDance open-sourced DeerFlow, a long-horizon SuperAgent framework that autonomously researches, codes, and creates. It leverages sandboxes, memory, tools, skills, and sub-agents to handle complex multi-step tasks, making it a powerful tool for developers building scalable AI workflows.

items.title: 面试官问你：“AI 能写 80% 的代码了，公司为什么还需要你？”
items.description: 先说一个事实：2026 年的技术面试，已经和两年前完全不一样了。两年前面试问的是："手写一个 Promise"、"说说 React Fiber 原理"...现在面试官默认你会用 AI。他们真正想知道的
items.summary_zh: 这篇文章探讨了在AI能写出80%代码的背景下，技术面试如何从考察基础原理转向考察程序员的独特价值。面试官默认你熟悉AI工具，他们更看重问题拆解、业务理解、架构思维和人机协作能力，提醒开发者要聚焦AI无法替代的核心竞争力。
items.summary_en: The article explores how technical interviews have transformed as AI now writes 80% of the code. Interviewers assume proficiency with AI tools and instead evaluate skills that make developers irreplaceable: problem decomposition, business understanding, architectural thinking, and effective human-AI collaboration. It cautions against over-reliance on AI-generated code and urges developers to cultivate uniquely human competencies for long-term career relevance.

items.title: 写给年轻程序员的几点建议-2
items.description: 现在互联网红利已经消失了，深知年轻程序员的不易，下面就浅薄地谈几点建议。中国人口基数比较大，要培养自己的 商业嗅觉。你能卖爆一个商品，就能获得巨大的财富。微信公众号如果能写出 几万 浏览量的文章，就有
items.summary_zh: 作者针对互联网红利消退的现状，向年轻程序员提出培养商业嗅觉和写作能力的建议。他认为在中国庞大的人口基数下，能卖爆一个商品或写出高阅读量的公众号文章就能获得巨大财富。文章强调技术之外的市场认知和内容表达能力同样重要，适合处于职业早期的程序员思考如何拓宽收入来源。
items.summary_en: The author offers advice for young programmers in the post-internet-bonus era, emphasizing the need to develop business acumen and writing skills. Given China's huge population, successfully selling a product or writing a viral WeChat article can bring significant wealth. The article argues that market insight and content communication are as crucial as technical skills, making it relevant for early-career programmers looking to diversify their income streams.

items.title: microsoft/TRELLIS.2
items.description: Native and Compact Structured Latents for 3D Generation
items.author: microsoft
items.summary_zh: Microsoft 开源了 TRELLIS.2，一种面向 3D 生成的模型，使用原生紧凑的结构化潜空间代替传统体素或点云表示，可生成高质量 3D 资产。适合 3D 内容生成、游戏与仿真领域的开发者和研究者。
items.summary_en: Microsoft has open-sourced TRELLIS.2, a 3D generation model that uses native and compact structured latents instead of conventional voxel or point-cloud representations. It yields high-quality 3D assets from text or images. Developers and researchers building 3D content pipelines, games, or simulations will want to evaluate it.

items.title: github/copilot-sdk
items.description: Multi-platform SDK for integrating GitHub Copilot Agent into apps and services
items.author: github
items.summary_zh: GitHub 发布官方 Copilot SDK，支持将 Copilot Agent 集成到桌面、Web 等各类应用中，提供跨平台能力。开发者可在自己的产品里直接调用 Copilot 的智能补全与对话功能，不必自己搭建模型链路。适合做 IDE 插件或 AI 助手类应用的团队评估。
items.summary_en: GitHub has released an official Copilot SDK that lets developers integrate the Copilot Agent into desktop, web, and other applications with cross-platform support. It provides direct access to Copilot's code completion and chat capabilities without building a model pipeline from scratch. Worth evaluating for teams building IDE plugins or AI assistant products.

items.title: 程序员副业 | 2026年4月复盘
items.description: 我看后台有人催更，确实很久没写复盘了，年后一直在折腾，今天有时间，来复盘下4月份做的事情吧，最近真的是疯狂在通宵编程哈哈，今天我开发的软件发布了新版本，稍微可以清闲一下。
items.summary_zh: 这是一位程序员分享的2026年4月副业复盘，作者回应读者催更，讲述了自己年后持续折腾、通宵编程开发软件并发布新版本的经历。文章展现了副业程序员面临的巨大时间投入与自我驱动力，同时也描述了新版本上线后的短暂轻松。对于同样在探索副业的开发者来说，这篇复盘既是一种共鸣，也是激励——持续投入终会带来可见的成果。
items.summary_en: A programmer shares their side project recap for April 2026, responding to readers who urged an update. The author describes an intense period of coding overnight after the new year, finally releasing a new version of their software. This post highlights the significant time commitment and self-discipline required for side projects, along with the fleeting relief of shipping a release. For developers juggling side hustles, this recap resonates deeply—it shows that sustained effort eventually pays off with tangible progress and a momentary break.

items.title: 2026编程圈很火的10个Skills
items.description: 前言 最近编程圈最火的一个词，非 Skills 莫属。 不是指程序员的技术能力，而是指 AI 编程助手的“技能包” 。 一套让 AI 从“随缘写代码”变成“按流程交付”的标准化工作流模块。 今天这篇文
items.summary_zh: 2026 年编程圈热议的 10 个 Skills 并非指程序员的技术能力，而是 AI 编程助手的“技能包”——一套标准化工作流模块，让 AI 从随缘写代码变为按流程交付。这些技能包覆盖代码审查、测试生成、文档编写等环节，旨在提升开发效率和代码质量。对正在探索 AI 辅助编程的团队和个人开发者而言，掌握这些技能包将成为提高生产力的关键。
items.summary_en: The 10 hottest Skills in programming circles for 2026 refer not to developers' own abilities but to standardized workflow modules for AI coding assistants. These skill packages transform AI from random code generation to structured delivery, covering code review, test generation, documentation, and more. For teams and individual developers exploring AI-assisted programming, mastering these skills is becoming essential for boosting productivity and code quality.

items.title: 2026 了，前端转 AI 全栈我是这么学的 😍😍😍
items.description: 最近，"前端已死，全栈永生" 又开始在技术圈流行。 支付宝体验技术部已经解散并完成拆分，原有人员分流到各条业务线。这件事传开以后，很多人又往下推一步，变成 "前端作为独立工种肯定会消失"。 更准确的事
items.summary_zh: 这篇文章从支付宝体验技术部解散说起，讨论“前端已死”背后的真实趋势，并给出前端转 AI 全栈的学习路线。作者认为前端作为独立工种不会消失，但技能栈需要重构，还分享了具体的项目实践建议。适合因为裁员焦虑的前端开发者读一读。
items.summary_en: This article uses the disbanding of Alipay's Experience Technology Department to analyze the real trend behind the 'frontend is dead' claim, then maps out a learning path from frontend to AI full-stack development. The author argues that frontend as a separate job won't vanish but its skill stack must be rebuilt, and offers concrete project suggestions. It's a useful read for frontend developers anxious about layoffs.

items.title: 普通程序员有没有必要学习 Agent 开发？
items.description: 大家好，我是双越。wangEditor 作者，前百度 滴滴 资深前端工程师，慕课网金牌讲师，PMP，前端面试派作者。本文讨论普通程序员要不要学习 AI Agent 开发。

items.summary_en: In this article, senior front-end engineer Shuangyue discusses whether ordinary programmers should learn AI Agent development. Drawing from his own experience, he analyzes the potential impact on career growth, arguing that while not everyone needs to dive in immediately, understanding this trend helps stay competitive in the AI wave. The piece sparks deep reflection on technology path choices.

By offering a drag-and-drop interface to connect models, data sources, and custom functions, it significantly lowers the barrier to creating AI applications. items.summary_en: Firecrawl is a powerful web API that enables developers to search, scrape, and interact with websites at scale. It solves common challenges like complex page structures and anti-bot measures, providing a reliable and scalable way to collect structured data. Data scientists, AI training teams, and application developers can use it to accelerate product iteration and research by extracting valuable information from massive web pages with ease. This tool lowers the barrier for web data acquisition, making it easier for intelligent applications to leverage real-time web content.

items.summary_zh: 阿里巴巴突然调整快递业务战略，标志着快递行业迎来重大变局。过去阿里通过菜鸟网络整合物流生态，如今转向更轻量化的模式，可能放弃自建物流的重资产路线，转而聚焦平台化和技术赋能。这一转向不仅影响菜鸟的上市计划，也重新定义了电商与物流的关系，对于快递公司和商家来说，都需要重新评估合作模式。
items.summary_en: Alibaba has made a sudden strategic pivot in its delivery business, signaling a major shift in the logistics industry. Previously, the company relied on Cainiao Network to build an integrated logistics ecosystem, but now it is moving toward a lighter model, possibly abandoning heavy asset investments in favor of platform-based services and technology enablement. This change not only impacts Cainiao's IPO plans but also redefines the relationship between e-commerce and logistics, forcing delivery companies and merchants to rethink their partnerships.

items.title: 刚刚，Kimi K3开源，2.8万亿参数砸向全球，硅谷巨头看傻了

items.summary_zh: AI 领域在短短一夜之间发生了巨变：OpenAI 突然放出了 GPT-5.6，性能大幅提升，但同时宣布停用 Codex，这个曾为开发者熟知的代码生成工具。另一边，Anthropic 的 Claude 因为新模型压力倍增，似乎不得不加快迭代步伐来应对竞争。整个行业节奏快得让人应接不暇，开发者需要迅速适应新工具。
items.summary_en: The AI landscape shifted overnight: OpenAI released GPT-5.6 with significant performance gains, yet simultaneously discontinued Codex, the well-known code generation tool. Meanwhile, Anthropic's Claude faces mounting pressure from the new release, likely forcing faster iterations to stay competitive. This rapid evolution demands developers quickly adapt to new tools, highlighting the breakneck pace of AI model competition.

The removals, involving top Chinese internet firms, are believed to be driven by content safety, data privacy concerns, and mounting regulatory compliance pressures. This move signals that as AI technology rapidly deploys, companies are proactively shrinking risk boundaries to prioritize legal compliance. For users, it may temporarily reduce available AI conversational tools, but it also indicates a shift from wild growth toward standardization, which in the long run could foster a more trustworthy AI ecosystem.

items.summary_zh: 这篇文章聚焦于“一人公司”创业模式，即由单一个体运营的小型科技企业。作者提供了如何选择合适的方法论，如精益创业和敏捷开发，以及装备库，包括工具链、云服务和AI助手的建议。对于独立开发者、自由职业者和微型创业者，这些指导可以帮助他们以最小成本高效构建和运营产品，实现从零到一的突破。

It offers practical advice on choosing the right methodologies, such as lean startup and agile, and tooling arsenal including development tools, cloud services, and AI assistants. For solo developers, freelancers, and micro-entrepreneurs, these insights enable cost-effective product building and operation, helping them achieve a breakthrough from zero to one.

items.title: Claude Code 80%的提示词说删就删，Anthropic用Fable 5打了个样：AI行业的“降本”才刚刚开始
items.summary_zh: Anthropic通过其产品Claude Code展示了惊人的降本能力：删掉80%的提示词后性能反而提升。他们借助自研的Fable 5框架，用更少的token生成更精准的代码，大幅降低推理成本。这预示着AI行业“降本”竞赛才刚刚开始，对于有大规模AI部署需求的企业，优化提示词将是关键突破口。
items.summary_en: Anthropic demonstrated remarkable cost reduction with Claude Code: removing 80% of prompt tokens actually improved performance. Using their proprietary Fable 5 framework, the system generates more accurate code with fewer tokens, slashing inference costs. This signals that the AI industry's 'cost reduction' race has just begun. For enterprises with large-scale AI deployments, optimizing prompts will be the key breakthrough.

items.title: 拒绝天价账单！OpenAI、Anthropic 自研芯片，剑指英伟达“暴利”护城河
items.summary_zh: OpenAI和Anthropic纷纷启动自研芯片项目，目标直指英伟达在AI训练市场上的暴利护城河。通过定制化硬件，它们希望大幅降低大模型训练的天价成本，同时提升效率与供应链自主权。这一动作不仅可能撼动英伟达的垄断地位，更意味着AI基础设施正在从通用GPU走向专用芯片时代，对整个产业生态产生深远影响。
items.summary_en: OpenAI and Anthropic have both launched in-house chip development projects, aiming to challenge Nvidia's profitable dominance in AI training hardware. By designing custom chips, they hope to significantly reduce the enormous cost of training large models while improving efficiency and supply chain independence. This move could shake Nvidia's monopoly and signal a shift from general-purpose GPUs to specialized AI chips, reshaping the entire industry ecosystem.

items.title: 史上最高调的AI重写：Claude花11天搞定Bun，创始人花一个月才敢交底
items.summary_zh: Anthropic的Claude AI在11天内重写了JavaScript运行时Bun的核心代码，但创始人Jarred Sumner花了一个月才敢对外公布这个消息。这个案例展示了AI在大型软件重写中的惊人效率和潜力，但同时也引发了关于代码质量、可维护性和安全风险的讨论。Sumner的谨慎态度反映出业界对AI生成代码缺乏足够信任和验证机制的现实。这件事给企业带来启示：AI重写可以大幅缩短开发周期，但必须配合严格的代码审查和测试流程，才能真正放心使用。
items.summary_en: Anthropic's Claude AI rewrote the core of Bun, a JavaScript runtime, in just 11 days, but founder Jarred Sumner waited a month before revealing it. This case highlights both the incredible speed of AI-driven code rewriting and the accompanying concerns over quality, maintainability, and security. Sumner's caution reflects the industry's lack of trust and verification mechanisms for AI-generated code. The takeaway for enterprises is that while AI can dramatically shorten development cycles, it must be paired with rigorous code review and testing before deployment can be fully trusted.

items.title: Java 实时系统扩容：事件驱动设计的隐性权衡
items.summary_zh: 文章深入分析了Java实时系统在扩容时采用事件驱动设计所面临的隐性权衡。虽然事件驱动架构能带来高吞吐和弹性扩展，但它也引入了额外的复杂性，如调试困难、延迟不确定性以及状态管理挑战。对于构建高性能分布式系统的开发者而言，理解这些权衡至关重要，因为盲目采用可能反而导致系统不稳定。
items.summary_en: This article delves into the hidden trade-offs of using event-driven design when scaling Java real-time systems. While event-driven architectures offer high throughput and elastic scalability, they also bring added complexity, such as debugging difficulties, latency unpredictability, and state management challenges. For developers building high-performance distributed systems, understanding these trade-offs is crucial, as blindly adopting event-driven patterns can lead to system instability instead of the desired benefits.

items.title: 从生成到交付，音视频 Agent 要有生产级开发套件
items.summary_zh: 随着音视频AI Agent从生成走向交付，业界意识到需要一个生产级开发套件来支撑全流程。该套件不仅要处理模型推理，还要覆盖编码、封装、分发等环节，确保实时性与质量。这篇文章强调了标准化工具链的重要性，它能让开发者更高效地构建可落地的音视频应用，推动AI在影视、直播等领域的实际部署。
items.summary_en: As AI agents for audio and video move from generation to delivery, the industry recognizes the need for a production-grade development suite to support the entire pipeline. Such a suite must handle not only model inference but also encoding, packaging, and distribution to ensure real-time performance and quality. This article emphasizes the importance of a standardized toolchain, enabling developers to build deployable audio-video applications more efficiently, thereby pushing AI adoption in filmmaking, live streaming, and more.

items.title: 大晓机器人首席科学家陶大程：世界模型的使命不是完整复制世界，而是精准支撑行动
items.summary_zh: 大晓机器人首席科学家陶大程提出，世界模型的核心目标不是完美复刻现实世界，而是为智能体提供足以支撑行动决策的精准预测。这一观点挑战了传统追求高保真模拟的做法，强调实用性优先。对于具身智能和机器人领域，这意味着模型设计应聚焦于任务相关的关键信息，而非浪费算力在无关细节上，从而让机器人更高效地与现实交互。
items.summary_en: Dr. Tao Dacheng, chief scientist at Daxia Robotics, argues that the primary mission of a world model is not to perfectly replicate the real world but to provide precise predictions that support actionable decisions. This view challenges the conventional pursuit of high-fidelity simulation and prioritizes practicality. For embodied AI and robotics, it suggests that model design should focus on task-critical information rather than wasting compute on irrelevant details, enabling robots to interact with the physical world more efficiently.

items.title: 从零开始预训练，蚂蚁灵波发布具身原生世界动作模型LingBot-VA 2.0
items.summary_zh: 蚂蚁集团旗下灵波团队近日发布了全新的具身原生世界动作模型LingBot-VA 2.0，和以往依赖仿真环境或迁移学习的方案不同，这次他们从零开始预训练这个模型，让机器人能更加自主地理解物理世界并执行复杂动作。这意味着机器人不再需要大量人工标注和场景适配，可以更快适应真实环境的变化。对于工业自动化和服务机器人领域来说，这个模型有望大幅降低部署成本，提升泛化能力，是具身智能走向实用化的重要一步。
items.summary_en: Ant Group's Lingbo team has released LingBot-VA 2.0, an embodied native world action model trained from scratch rather than relying on simulation or transfer learning. This approach allows robots to better understand physical environments and perform complex actions without extensive manual annotation or scene adaptation. The model significantly improves generalization and reduces deployment costs, making it a crucial step toward practical embodied intelligence in industrial automation and service robotics.

items.title: GPT-5.6全面围剿Claude Fable 5，“超级应用”ChatGPT Work上位，Altman紧急澄清：不会取代Coedx
items.summary_zh: OpenAI推出的GPT-5.6模型正全面对标并压制Anthropic的Claude Fable 5，同时将ChatGPT Work打造成集办公、创作于一体的“超级应用”。面对外界关于它会取代现有开发者工具Coedx的猜测，Sam Altman紧急澄清，称两者定位不同，ChatGPT Work专注于通用生产力，不会替代专业的代码开发平台。这一消息在开发者社区引发热议，反映了AI巨头在应用层争夺用户的激烈竞争。
items.summary_en: OpenAI's GPT-5.6 model is going head-to-head with Anthropic's Claude Fable 5, while turning ChatGPT Work into a 'super app' that integrates office productivity and creative tasks. Amid speculation that it might replace existing developer tools like Coedx, Sam Altman quickly clarified that ChatGPT Work targets general productivity and won't replace specialized coding platforms. This news has sparked heated debate among developers, reflecting the intense competition among AI giants at the application layer.

items.title: GitHub 的旧模式被 AI 击穿，Cursor、GitLab、Zed 各自开打
items.summary_zh: GitHub原有的代码托管与协作模式正被AI浪潮彻底颠覆，Cursor、GitLab和Zed等新工具纷纷发力，各自以AI辅助编程、智能协作和轻量编辑器等不同路线争夺开发者。这场变革之所以重要，是因为AI让代码生成、审查和合并变得高度自动化，传统基于Pull Request的工作流可能被重新定义。开发者和团队需要重新思考如何更高效地协同编码。
items.summary_en: GitHub's traditional code hosting and collaboration model is being disrupted by AI, with tools like Cursor, GitLab, and Zed each taking different approaches—AI-assisted coding, smart collaboration, and lightweight editing—to win over developers. This shift matters because AI automates code generation, review, and merging, potentially redefining the classic pull-request workflow. Developers and teams must rethink how to collaborate efficiently in this new landscape.

items.summary_zh: 苹果公司近日对OpenAI提起民事诉讼，指控多名前员工在离职时窃取了与人工智能研发相关的商业机密。这些员工据称带走了内部技术文档和核心算法，并可能用于竞争项目。这起诉讼不仅反映了硅谷两大科技巨头在人才和知识产权上的激烈争夺，也凸显了AI领域日益敏感的技术保密问题。对于科技行业观察者而言，这场法律战的结果或许会重塑企业防范员工跳槽时的保密协议设计。
items.summary_en: Apple has filed a lawsuit against OpenAI, alleging that several former employees stole trade secrets related to artificial intelligence research. The complaint claims these workers took proprietary technical documents and core algorithms before leaving for positions that could benefit competing projects. This legal battle underscores the fierce competition for talent and intellectual property between two Silicon Valley giants, and highlights the growing sensitivity of technology secrecy in the AI industry. For tech observers, the outcome may influence how companies craft confidentiality agreements to guard against employee poaching.

items.title: EU Parliament greenlights Chat Control 1.0
items.author: rapnie
items.summary_zh: 欧盟议会通过了备受争议的Chat Control 1.0法案，要求数字平台扫描并报告涉及儿童性虐待材料的私密通信内容。这项立法引发了隐私与安全之间的激烈辩论，支持者认为它有助于保护儿童，而反对者警告这可能破坏端到端加密并开创大规模监控的先例。对于关注数字权利和隐私保护的群体来说，这是一个需要密切关注的发展。
items.summary_en: The European Parliament has approved the controversial Chat Control 1.0 regulation, requiring digital platforms to scan private communications for child sexual abuse material. The law sparks intense debate between child safety advocates and privacy defenders, who warn it undermines end-to-end encryption and sets a precedent for mass surveillance. Anyone concerned about digital rights and encryption should pay close attention to this development.

items.title: GPT-5.6
items.author: logickkk1
items.summary_zh: 关于GPT-5.6的传闻在开发者社区悄然升温，据称这是OpenAI内部测试的新一代模型，在推理效率和长文本处理上有显著提升。尽管官方未确认，但泄露的基准测试显示其在复杂编程和数学任务上超越了现有版本。如果属实，这将意味着AI模型在实用性和响应速度上迈入新台阶，对依赖语言模型的开发者和企业影响深远。
items.summary_en: Rumors about GPT-5.6, an alleged internal iteration from OpenAI, have sparked excitement in the developer community. Leaked benchmarks suggest it offers substantial improvements in reasoning efficiency and long-context handling, outperforming current models on complex coding and math tasks. While OpenAI hasn't confirmed the release, the speculation points to a possible leap in practical AI utility, making responses faster and more accurate. For developers and businesses relying on language models, even incremental upgrades can translate into better user experiences and lower latency. This potential release underscores the rapid pace of AI advancement.

items.title: Decoding the obfuscated bash script on a Uniqlo t-shirt
items.author: speerer
items.summary_zh: 一位技术爱好者解析了优衣库T恤上印制的混淆bash脚本，发现它实际上是一个恶作剧程序，通过复杂的字符串操作和陷阱逻辑来隐藏其真实功能。这篇分析展示了逆向工程乐趣，也提醒大家即使看似无害的代码也可能暗藏玄机。对于安全研究人员和编程爱好者来说，这是一次趣味与技术并重的解谜之旅。
items.summary_en: A tech enthusiast meticulously dissected an obfuscated bash script printed on a Uniqlo t-shirt, revealing it to be a playful prank program designed to confuse casual observers. The script uses intricate string manipulations and trap commands to mask its true purpose, which is simply to echo a message. This analysis highlights the fun side of reverse engineering and serves as a reminder that even innocuous-looking code can contain hidden complexity. It's a delightful read for security researchers and programming hobbyists who enjoy a good puzzle.

items.title: Zig Creator Calls Spade a Spade, Anthropic Blows Smoke
items.author: crowdhailer
items.summary_zh: Zig语言的创始人近日直言不讳地批评了人工智能公司Anthropic，指责其营销宣传充斥着虚假和夸大的内容。他在社交媒体上毫不留情地指出，Anthropic所谓的“安全、负责任”的AI不过是烟雾弹，实际行为与其承诺严重不符。这场公开争执在开发者社区引发热议，许多人赞赏他的坦率，认为这揭示了AI行业普遍存在的过度包装问题。事件提醒我们，技术的真正价值取决于透明度和诚实，而非华丽的辞藻。
items.summary_en: The creator of the Zig programming language openly criticized AI company Anthropic for what he called misleading marketing and exaggerated claims. In a blunt online post, he accused Anthropic of blowing smoke about its safety and responsibility commitments while failing to deliver on those promises. The exchange has stirred significant discussion in the developer community, with many applauding his candor and seeing it as a reflection of broader issues in the AI industry where hype often overshadows substance. This moment underscores the importance of transparency and honesty in technology, reminding us that real progress depends on truth, not rhetoric.

items.title: Context.dev
items.description: One API to scrape, enrich, and extract the internet
items.summary_zh: Context.dev 提供单一 API，即可完成网页爬取、数据丰富和信息提取，极大简化了从互联网获取结构化数据的流程。无论是做市场调研、竞争分析还是构建数据产品，开发者都能通过这一接口快速获取所需信息，避免自建爬虫的繁琐与维护成本。
items.summary_en: Context.dev offers a single API for scraping, enriching, and extracting data from the web, solving the headache of managing multiple tools. Developers and data scientists can quickly pull structured information from any website for market research, competitive analysis, or building data-driven products. It abstracts away the complexity of building and maintaining custom scrapers, saving time and effort.

items.title: ClawTeams
items.description: The first goal-driven, proactive AI team for e-commerce
items.summary_zh: ClawTeams 是首个面向电商的目标驱动型主动AI团队。它不像传统工具那样被动等待指令，而是自主分析店铺数据，主动制定运营目标并自动执行，比如优化广告投放、调整库存或提升转化率。对于忙于日常运营的电商卖家来说，ClawTeams就像一位不知疲倦的运营总监，帮助商家在复杂竞争中更高效地达成销售目标。
items.summary_en: ClawTeams is the first goal-driven, proactive AI team built specifically for e-commerce. Instead of waiting for manual commands, it autonomously analyzes store data, sets objectives, and takes actions—like optimizing ad spend, adjusting inventory, or boosting conversions. For busy e-commerce merchants drowning in daily operations, ClawTeams acts like a tireless operations director, helping them hit sales targets more efficiently in a competitive landscape.

items.title: Pazi
items.description: Vibe code business operations
items.summary_zh: Pazi 提出了一种全新的业务运营方式——“氛围代码”，即用类似编程的思维和工具来编排业务流程，但操作界面友好直观，不需要传统编码背景。它让团队可以通过定义“氛围”或模式来自动化审批、任务分配等日常操作，使运营更加灵活、透明且易于调整。适合希望用轻量自动化提升效率的业务团队，尤其适合初创公司。
items.summary_en: Pazi introduces 'vibe code' for business operations—a fresh approach that lets you orchestrate workflows using programming-like logic through an intuitive interface, without actual coding. Teams define 'vibes' or patterns to automate approvals, task assignments, and more, making operations flexible, transparent, and easy to tweak. It's ideal for small teams and startups seeking lightweight automation to streamline daily processes without heavy engineering overhead.

items.title: ExploreYC
items.description: Open-source API for Y Combinator & a16z company data
items.summary_zh: ExploreYC是一个开源API，提供了Y Combinator和a16z投资组合公司的结构化数据访问，包括公司名称、简介、融资轮次和创始团队信息。创业者、投资者和研究人员可以通过该API轻松获取这些顶级孵化器和风投的公开数据，用于市场分析、竞品研究或个人项目。开源特性使得任何人都可以部署或扩展这个数据服务。
items.summary_en: ExploreYC is an open-source API that provides structured access to data from Y Combinator and a16z portfolio companies, including company names, descriptions, funding rounds, and founder details. Entrepreneurs, investors, and researchers can easily retrieve this publicly available data for market analysis, competitive research, or personal projects. Its open-source nature allows anyone to deploy or extend the data service.

items.title: ChatCut
items.description: Your AI video editor in ChatGPT, desktop, and web
items.summary_zh: ChatCut是一款集成在ChatGPT、桌面端和网页端的AI视频编辑器。用户只需用自然语言描述剪辑需求，AI就能自动完成剪切、转场和特效添加等操作。它大幅降低了视频制作的门槛，适合内容创作者和普通用户快速生成高质量视频内容，无需学习专业软件。
items.summary_en: ChatCut is an AI-powered video editor accessible through ChatGPT, desktop app, and web browser. Users simply describe their editing needs in natural language, and the AI handles cutting, transitions, and effects automatically. This significantly lowers the barrier for video creation, making it ideal for content creators and casual users who want professional results without mastering complex editing software.

items.title: Auriko
items.description: Trading desk for LLM calls
items.summary_zh: Auriko是一个专为大模型调用设计的交易平台，它让开发者能够像交易股票一样买卖LLM的API调用配额。通过这个平台，你可以灵活地管理和优化模型调用成本，在高峰期买入更多调用次数，在低谷时出售多余配额。对于经常使用多个大模型API的团队来说，Auriko提供了一种全新的成本控制方式，让资源分配更加经济和高效。
items.summary_en: Auriko is a trading desk designed specifically for LLM API calls, allowing developers to buy and sell call quotas just like stocks. This platform enables flexible cost management and resource allocation—purchase more calls during peak demand and sell excess during lulls. For teams that rely on multiple large language models, Auriko offers a novel way to optimize spending and ensure efficient usage, making it a compelling tool for cost-conscious AI developers.

items.title: Fypro
items.description: Convert your TikTok followers into paying customers
items.summary_zh: Fypro 帮助 TikTok 创作者和品牌将粉丝有效转化为付费客户，通过智能链接、数据分析等功能实现社交流量变现。无需粉丝离开平台，即可引导他们完成购买、订阅等操作。对于希望从内容创作中获得收益的博主来说，这款工具简化了转化路径，提升了商业价值。
items.summary_en: Fypro enables TikTok creators and brands to convert their followers into paying customers without driving them away from the platform. With smart links, analytics, and targeted calls-to-action, it streamlines the monetization of social traffic. Ideal for influencers and e-commerce sellers, it reduces friction in the buyer journey and helps turn engagement into revenue effortlessly.

items.title: V2Fun
items.description: Generate 3D character with 8K textures and AI motion capture
items.summary_zh: V2Fun是一款面向创作者和游戏开发者的3D角色生成工具，它能通过AI自动生成具有8K纹理的高质量3D角色模型，并内置AI动作捕捉功能，让角色立刻拥有流畅的动画。过去，制作一个类似的精细角色需要专业的建模师、纹理艺术家和动捕设备，耗时数天甚至数周；而V2Fun将这一过程缩短到几分钟，大幅降低了3D内容创作的门槛。无论是独立游戏制作者、虚拟主播，还是电商展示中的数字人形象，都能借助它快速生成可用资产。
items.summary_en: V2Fun is a 3D character generation tool that uses AI to produce high-quality models with 8K textures and includes AI-powered motion capture for instant animation. What once required a team of professional modelers, texture artists, and expensive motion capture equipment—taking days or weeks—can now be done in minutes. This dramatically lowers the barrier for independent game developers, virtual streamers, and digital human creators in e-commerce, enabling them to quickly generate production-ready characters without specialized skills. It solves the bottleneck of 3D asset creation: speed versus quality.
